verdict.rationale: API versioning and deprecation policy are a fair axis for a payments API platform, but the evidence pack has no documentation of a versioning scheme, version lifecycle, or deprecation or sunset policy. The only hint is an incidental '/v1/ingestions' path on the Product Feed API, which shows a version label on one endpoint but not a documented versioning or deprecation commitment a user could rely on.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
